dataset: DataMeet India community Census 2011 district boundaries
attribution: District boundaries provided by DataMeet Community Maps Project.
transformation: Selected the districts listed in config/districts.yaml by Census 2011 (ST_CEN_CD, DT_CEN_CD) from 2011_Dist.shp and converted to GeoJSON with mapshaper 0.7.69 (-simplify 12% keep-shapes, precision 0.0001). Geometry is made valid with ST_MakeValid on load. Ladakh districts (Leh, Kargil) are part of Jammu and Kashmir in Census 2011.
